cards.name: Health Careers Summer Camp
cards.description: Students stay in UNC Asheville dorms and participate in hands-on healthcare activities on the UNC Asheville and MAHEC campuses. The four-day, three-night camp also includes a trip to the Adventure Center of Asheville’s ropes course.

prices.label: There is no cost for students to attend.

availability.text: Applications for the 2026 season have closed.

cards.review_notes: The camp description includes rising juniors, seniors, or class of 2026 seniors, but the eligibility section only lists rising high school juniors and seniors from rural WNC. Grades encode the rising students; confirm eligibility for graduating seniors. The page also requires a strong desire to pursue a healthcare career and a minimum weighted GPA of 3.0. UNC Asheville is the overnight lodging venue; its official campus address is used, but the camp does not identify a specific dorm or check-in location. MAHEC and the Adventure Center are activity destinations, not confirmed drop-off sites.
